cues.en: Some things in life are bad.
They can really make you mad.
Other things just make you swear and curse.
cues.zh: 还有些事只会让你骂骂咧咧。

cues.en: When you're chewing on laughs gristle,
cues.zh: 当你嚼着生活的苦头时，

cues.en: and this'll help things turn out for the best.
cues.zh: 这会让事情往最好的方向发展。

cues.en: look on the light side of life.
If life seems jolly rotten, there's something you've forgotten,
cues.zh: 如果生活看起来一团糟，那是有件事你忘了，

cues.en: and that's to laugh and smile and dance and sing.
cues.zh: 那就是笑一笑、跳一跳、唱一唱。

cues.en: When you're feeling in the dumps,
Just purse your lips and whistle, That's the thing.
cues.zh: 噘起嘴，吹声口哨，就对了。

cues.en: and death's the final word. You must always face the curtain with a bat.
cues.zh: 死亡才是最终结局。面对落幕时，你得手持球棒。

cues.en: Forget about your scene. Give the audience a go in. Enjoy
cues.zh: 别管你的戏份了。让观众登场。尽情享受，

cues.en: before you draw your terminal breath.
cues.zh: 趁你还没吐出最后一口气。

cues.en: Life's a laugh, and death's a joke. It's true.
cues.zh: 活着是场欢笑，死亡是个玩笑。确实如此。

cues.en: You'll see it's all a show. Keep them laughing as you go. Just remember that the last laugh is on you.
cues.zh: 你会明白这一切都是场戏。退场时让大家笑一笑，只要记住，最后被嘲弄的其实是你自己。

cues.en: to Bernie, I said, they'll never make that money back.
cues.zh: 说，我说，他们绝对回不了本。
